owner_rules.rule: Three consecutive merged PRs on one line that do not move the milestone headline force a pivot card.
A negative closes a configuration, never a mechanism. Decisive runs use >=2 seeds or >=200 fresh rows, train the mechanism in, and carry a TEST FITNESS: FIT review on the milestone before compute.

No softmax anywhere in the active project: training, serving, sampling, objectives, auxiliary losses, teachers, comparators. No table/renamed equivalent. Interlock: `uor-harness ratchet d23|d25` (Rust, #2346) - `scripts/check_no_softmax.py` is retired and kept only as dated evidence; a pre-registration sheet that names the Python script sends a lab to a file that no longer enforces anything.
No CPU model compute; no GPU on work that cannot change a decision. A host-side fallback is a defect, not a cost to report.
No softplus, sigmoid or tanh anywhere: the scalar-activation carve-out is closed.

No matmul and no softmax anywhere, including GPU training: the owner ruled on 12 October 'no matmul at all anywhere, same with softmax - there is a ternary alternative with xor that may work'. The earlier conflict with agent-execution-policy.json is resolved by that ruling; the policy file's 'training may use matrix multiplication' sentence is stale and should be corrected.
owner_rules.source: https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/issues/2029#issuecomment-6135511346; owner ruling recorded in DECISIONS.md D25 (harness session, 12 October 2026)

owner_rules.rule: OP1 runs the Hamilton rotation gate G2 only; the rectified-square arm G1 is withdrawn as non-geometric. A G2 miss closes that configuration only (D22); there is no non-geometric fallback.
The ban is on the dense SwiGLU MLP, not on a feed-forward block built from the project's geometry; a Hamilton gate plus Hamilton projections is acceptable.

The rules as of 2026-10-12 21:55 are the COMPLETE constraint set until the first compliant training run (rung 0 on the compliant trunk) reports. New concerns need a proposal card and take effect only after that run; cost or safety problems are the only exception. A result that needed softmax anywhere is not progress on any line.

Current geometric operator phase: OP2 first -> OP1 G2 only -> OP3a -> lawful rung0 after hold release -> OP4/rung0b; OP3b later research. Training and independent M2 rental hold remain. FIT lifts no hold; preserve peer work and frozen constraint set.

Ternary/XOR is an owner-suggested candidate replacement arithmetic, not an adopted mechanism and not yet shown to be geometric. It enters as a proposal under the D25 rule freeze; it is unimplemented, unmeasured and must pass a prospective TEST FITNESS review before any compute. See docs/mechanisms/ternary-xor-arithmetic.md.
owner_rules.source: Owner ruling, 12 October 2026 (harness session); DECISIONS.md D25

owner_rules.rule: No transformer or neural-network comparisons of ANY kind - comparators, controls, baselines, teachers, neural graders - until the owner declares the native model works end to end; that declaration is the owner's, not a lab's. Panels are scored with DETERMINISTIC checks only (membership checks, exact-answer oracles); a bar scorable only by a neural grader is recorded BLOCKED and is NOT RUN. This includes the v5 reply panel's grade-replies qwen2.5:7b grader.

No banned mechanism may exist in any compiled or loaded module - presence counts, not only execution. NVRTC (runtime compilation) is banned project-wide; all CUDA kernels compile ahead of time via nvcc into named PTX/cubin modules. Interlock: `uor-harness ratchet d25` and the d29_compiled_modules test.

No result is ruled out on an instrument technicality. A check must answer the four authority questions in pm-rules.md R12 before it has veto power; when a check fails anyway, the instrument artefact is diagnosed and repaired rather than reported as a model negative. Supersedes older text that allows a first-failure stop or treats an instrument artefact as a code blocker.

Active discrete geometric substrate (`crates/uor-r4-discrete`, Dose 1): model computation and its instruments are discrete/exact and GPU-only - no floating-point forward, gradients, optimizer or numerical model instrument on that path, and no matrix multiplication. Use native SpiralCore/E8/FBS geometry with one integer input/carry/output writer. D37 revises D32's offline-training float ban in separately scanned float modules; the discrete path, D11 serving and the October 14 zeta-zero exception are unchanged. Both training holds remain HELD; a FIT review releases neither.

Floating point is legal in offline training only: float forward passes, gradients and optimizers, and offline numerical training instruments, in a separately scanned float module that names its pre-registration (R12/D31), remains geometric (SpiralCore/E8/FBS, icosian/quaternion, prime/zeta), has its own scanned allowlist entry added and reviewed with that pre-registration (never by widening the discrete crate's scan), and reports its export gap. Softmax/squashing (D23/D25) and dense matrix multiplication (D25/D30) stay banned everywhere; model compute stays GPU-only (D24); the exported/served artifact is D11 integer/table only, with no float, transcendental or multiplier instruction; the October 14 complex-plane zeta-zero exception stays separate; archived float sheets return only by re-registration and a fresh FIT; the active discrete Dose 1 and all holds are unchanged. Releases no hold, FIT or compute.
